run_train_faceid_ip_adapter: run the training script for IP-Adapter FaceID with pretrained model, data JSON, and image encoder paths
create_dataset_mydataset: create a MyDataset instance that loads images and face ID embeddings from a JSON manifest for diffusion training
build_collate_fn: build a collate_fn that stacks image tensors, tokenized text, and face ID embeddings into batched dictionaries
create_ip_adapter: create an IPAdapter module that projects image embeddings into tokens and concatenates them with text hidden states
test_parse_args: test parse_args to validate CLI arguments for pretrained model path, data JSON, image encoder, and training hyperparameters
